prompt: Create a project-ready background image asset extracted/reconstructed from ONLY the green football pitch at the top of this approved mobile UI mockup. The reference image is STYLE AND COMPOSITION reference; output must contain ONLY the standalone horizontal football pitch, no UI or screenshot framing. Landscape aspect ratio approximately 2.25:1. Full rectangular image with square corners and green pixels all the way to the four edges; clipping/rounded corners will be applied in app code. Match the approved pitch closely: natural rich medium green grass, restrained realistic fine turf grain, alternating subtle VERTICAL mowing stripes (left-to-right alternating shades), thin ivory-white outer field boundary inset about 3% horizontally and 5% vertically, halfway vertical line and centre circle, penalty and six-yard boxes at BOTH extreme ends, tiny corner arcs. Football goals centered vertically at the extreme PHYSICAL LEFT and RIGHT, facing inward horizontally. Goals are elegant small white three-dimensional frames with pale fine netting, exactly like the reference: each goal occupies roughly 4% of image width and 28% of image height, at each edge, clearly recognizable. Show the COMPLETE symmetrical pitch and BOTH complete goals, no cropping. Preserve the professional sophisticated sports-app look, no cartoons. The central third of the grass must be somewhat calm/darker green so overlaid white timer text will read clearly; field lines subtly translucent, not thick/bright. No black panels, no fog, no large shadow blobs. Critical: REMOVE ALL TEXT, ALL NUMBERS, ALL LABELS, ALL TEAM SHIRTS, ALL ICONS, ALL CHIPS, ALL BALLS, ALL AVATARS, ALL WHITE UI CARDS, ALL BUTTONS. Do not retain any '00:00' or score zeros. No watermarks, logos, English or Hebrew characters. This is only a clean reusable turf-and-goals background; every piece of data will be rendered live by the application.
